published_value.explain: Schedule D line 3, column (h), is your short-term Form 8949 box C gain or loss, proceeds minus basis plus adjustments.

computed_zero.explain: Schedule D line 3, column (h), is zero. Either no short-term sale you received no Form 1099-B for is recorded and your Form 8949 answers confirm it, or your box C proceeds, basis, and adjustments net to zero.

closure_backed_zero.explain: Schedule D line 3, column (h), is zero. No short-term sale you received no Form 1099-B for is recorded, and your answer about those sales confirms the list is complete.

blocked.explain: Schedule D line 3, column (h), has no value yet. It waits for your answers about sales you received no Form 1099-B for and about Form 8949, or for each recorded short-term sale of that kind to have its proceeds and basis and pass its checks.
